faqs.q: How can I apply for ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can apply for this credit card through both online and offline modes. To apply online, you can visit the official website of the bank and fill out the application form. If you want to apply offline, you need to visit the nearest bank branch.

faqs.q: How much time will it take for the delivery of items I purchased by redeeming my reward points?
faqs.a: The redeemed items generally take up to 10 working days to reach the cardholder.

faqs.q: Can I make purchases online using my ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, ICICI Bank Sapphiro Credit Card is enabled with the online purchase option and you can use it to make purchases on the website of all domestic online retailers as well as a few international retailers.

faqs.q: How can I avoid paying the annual fee of ICICI Sapphiro Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can avail the annual card fee waiver facility by spending a minimum of Rs. 6 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: Is ICICI Sapphiro Credit Card Lifetime Free?
faqs.answer: Yes, the ICICI Sapphiro Credit Card is often offered as Lifetime Free (LTF) under alumni programs or pre-approved offers.

faqs.question: What is the reward rate of ICICI Sapphiro Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers around 0.25% to 0.5% return on domestic spends and up to 1% on international spends.

faqs.question: Does ICICI Sapphiro have lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes, 4 domestic visits per quarter (with spend condition) and 2 international visits per year.

faqs.question: Is there a spend requirement for BookMyShow offer?
faqs.answer: Yes, ₹25,000 spend in the previous calendar quarter is required.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on ICICI Sapphiro Credit Card?
Is ICICI Sapphiro worth it?
faqs.answer: Best suited as a Lifetime Free card. Limited value as a paid card.
